metric: coverage(question, event) = |T(question) & T(event)| / |T(question)|, T(s) = set(re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_]{3,}', s.lower()))
non_target_exhaustive_definition: per golden, the mean coverage over EVERY non-target event of the same attempt; no seed, no draw
non_target_sampled_definition: one uniformly random non-target event of the same attempt, seed 7
